account: Verified personal DEV TEST account; no credential or account content retained
browser: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 on Linux ARM64 dev host
method: Desktop user clicks; mobile hash route transitions; content-ready DOM condition followed by the next requestAnimationFrame. Instrumented fetch, WebCrypto decrypt, IndexedDB requests and long tasks. No full HAR, trace or account-content exports.
privacy: Only normalized endpoint paths, timings, counts and bundle identifiers are retained. Screenshots and credentials are excluded.
limitations: Small observational sample, not a statistically representative percentile benchmark.
Mobile viewport is not physical mobile hardware.
Crypto/IndexedDB duration sums overlap and are not a decomposition of wall time.
The first project detail settled to a README error; exclude it from successful detail timing.
One attempted chat switch selected the already active chat and timed out; exclude it.
Update notification intercepted some clicks; those attempts produced no valid sample.
Reload loaded a newer bundle; use it only as qualitative recovery evidence, not a same-build timing comparison.
Chat A and B were verified to have encrypted titles and wrapped chat keys; each displayed two source messages with embeds.
The deployed bundle identifiers do not establish equality with the local source revision.
